quickactions.action.pack.edit.fix_compat: Marks the pack as compatible with the current game version

This does not update the pack's textures to the latest version. It only changes the supported version range in pack.mcmeta, so the game stops marking the pack as incompatible. If the pack uses outdated file names, some textures may still not work. Available only for packs the game marks as incompatible.
